plugin.name: Tool result compression
plugin.description: Compresses historical tool call results in the Router request pipeline: noise filtering, duplicate line folding, head/tail truncation and command-output filters, keeping the newest results verbatim.
plugin.lifecycle: Can be disabled: once off, request bodies are left untouched while stats keep counting. Compression is not a data-safety capability — on failure the original payload is always passed through instead of blocking the request.
card.errors_hint: Original payload passed through when processing fails
settings.savings_hint: Chars are exact; tokens are estimated (about 4 chars/token for Latin text, 1.5 for CJK) and only indicate magnitude.
settings.empty_state: No compression yet. Stats appear once requests carry tool results.
settings.strategy_hint: A larger fidelity window is safer; a lower threshold compresses harder. Changes are saved to the plugin's own config immediately.
settings.enable_caption: When off, request bodies are left untouched but stats keep counting.
settings.level_custom: Custom values (threshold or window edited manually)
settings.keep_recent_watermark: Tool results at the tail kept verbatim
settings.min_saving_watermark: Keep the original when savings fall below this
settings.reset_stats_caption: Clears counters only; config and behavior are untouched
